name: EvidenceCard
description: A captured page on a white card: cropped to the evidence asset's proving sentence (its box) with some page above and below, the sentence enlarged to the clip box width (at most 2x), a highlighter sweeping across it, and the source under the card. The card hugs the crop; give it a wide box (a long sentence in a narrow box reads small).

asset.description: id of an evidence asset (from capture); its box marks the proving sentence

source.description: line under the card (at least 28 px, two lines if long); default: 来源：<the asset's site, without www.>; "" hides it

context.description: capture pixels of page shown above and below the sentence (captures are 3x, so 120 is about one line)

highlight.description: sweep a highlighter across the sentence

highlight_at.description: Time the sweep starts: "line:5+0.5" or seconds from the clip start. Default: 0.3 s into the clip

ground.description: what the card sits on; sets the source line colour and the shadow
